body_html: @doomquasar @film_girl @spacekatgat I am the bad speller. Just finished Episode 22. It wasn't so much the fangirl love, just think the watch stuff was starting to make me throw up in my mouth. Simone had me worried that WWWDC show would be nothing but watch but it was great. Critical but not gushing review....and my original critique was your Star Wars desert was dated and not nerdy enough. We are going to see the rise of Ashoka.
